searchText: After the merge: will the consessus layer use ethereum webassembly or continu to apply evm? The merge is just switching of consensus protocols. Nothing else changes, so EVM it is And after cleanup or sharding? Is it somewhere on the roadmap? Not very high on the priority list I would imagine, but keeping a close eye on developments on the rollup front. I personally think it would be great if Ethereum becomes VM agnostic or something (i.e. just a data availability layer), but who knows 😉 Are there any ongoing research repo’s on this topic currently? Would be interesting to work on this For data availability/roll up stuff, John Adlers talks/posts maybe? E.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoWMLoeQGeI Thanks!
